terminals.name: dev-server
terminals.description: MASSFRONT static dev server (serve.mjs) on http://127.0.0.1:8100 serving the packed www/ with correct wasm/ktx2 MIME types. Open in a browser to load the game. NOTE: the WebGL2 engine requires a hardware GPU; on GPU-less VMs it shows 'GRAPHICS SESSION UNAVAILABLE' by design.
